source_edition: ISA Data Model Specification release 6.0 document revision 12, 31 October 2023

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Power, printed p.15 / PDF p.30
primary_records.proposed_label: Variable-power level as a percentage of the available maximum
primary_records.original_meaning: For a device supporting variable power, the given power level is expressed as a percentage of its maximum available power.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: This is not stored-energy percentage, consumed watts or a transmit-power measurement. The definition does not specify an input/output role or assert that a setting was commanded or applied. The Percent base type does not impose a universal 0–100 cap.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Power State, printed p.15 / PDF p.30
primary_records.proposed_label: Reported condition of power to the component
primary_records.original_meaning: The current condition of power to the component, expressed through General State: required code, optional component-specific machine subcode and optional human-readable details.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a fabricated ON/OFF enumeration, the whole component operating condition, battery percentage, authorization state or independently verified supply condition. No live value is inferred.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Reserve Capacity, printed p.16 / PDF p.31
primary_records.proposed_label: Reported energy reserve relative to maximum capacity
primary_records.original_meaning: Current energy reserve as a percentage of maximum capacity, with fuel-tank and battery-level uses identified by the source. Measured Percent carries required value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not rated mAh/Wh, available instantaneous power, remaining time or a measured value for a reference design. Optional error is not automatically zero; its native convention is plus/minus one standard deviation.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Satellites, printed p.16 / PDF p.31
primary_records.original_meaning: Number of satellites in use, encoded as Count with required integer value and optional integer error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not satellites merely visible/available, a specified constellation, a count of installed receivers or evidence of position accuracy. No count, reset rule or fixed acquisition interval is invented.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Shots, printed p.16 / PDF p.31
primary_records.original_meaning: Number of times the laser has been used, encoded as Count with required value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not firearm shots, a general observation count, or a guaranteed pulse-by-pulse count. The source does not define reset policy or a lifetime/time-window scope. A counter definition is not evidence that a particular laser fired.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Tamper State, printed p.17 / PDF p.32
primary_records.original_meaning: The tamper state of the device, using the shared General State structure and General Code enumeration.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Accepted extension, not core. No particular tamper detector, alarm, binary TAMPERED/UNTAMPERED enum, operator action or incident history is defined here; preserve the supplied code/subcode/details roles.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Temperature, printed p.17 / PDF p.32
primary_records.original_meaning: Internal temperature of the device, represented by Measured Celsius with required temperature value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Accepted extension, not ambient-air temperature, a rated operating-temperature range or a specific case measurement. The Celsius type has source range [-273.15, infinity); optional error uses plus/minus one standard deviation and is not fabricated when absent.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Time to Empty, printed p.17 / PDF p.32
primary_records.proposed_label: Estimated time to empty under expected usage
primary_records.original_meaning: Time to empty based on expected usage, represented by Measured Secs with required value in seconds and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not an absolute exhaustion timestamp, unconditional runtime guarantee, observation resultTime, sample period or a source-specified prediction algorithm. Preserve its dependency on expected usage and the optional-error convention.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Polarity, printed p.15 / PDF p.30
primary_records.original_meaning: Color palette used to visualize thermal energy. The native Polarity enumeration describes BLACK HOT and WHITE HOT presentations.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: This concerns thermal-image display, not electrical polarity, laser polarization or the scene temperature itself. Preserve the original named values; the source does not mark this enumeration sealed. No additional palette is inferred.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Pulse Interval, printed p.15 / PDF p.30
primary_records.original_meaning: Time interval between a laser's pulses, represented by Measured Secs with required value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not pulse duration, scan-cycle duration, generic sampling cadence or an absolute timestamp. The property does not establish actual emission or a source value for any case. Do not infer repetition frequency or uncertainty by inversion.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Quality, printed p.15 / PDF p.30
primary_records.original_meaning: Quality of the output produced by the component, expressed through the context-dependent Himelo levels VERY HIGH, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW and VERY LOW.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a quantitative accuracy or confidence measure, not per-observation QA flags, and not independently validated output quality. No numerical thresholds or ranking scores are specified. Distinct from output Resolution despite sharing the same type.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Radar Mode, printed p.15 / PDF p.30
primary_records.original_meaning: Current radar mode of the component, represented as a single native String.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Current radar-specific configuration, not a supported/default mode list, general operating condition or command. No mode vocabulary or applied case value is inferred. Related to the existing Source-reported operating mode row, while preserving the separately qualified Camera Mode representation.
primary_records.related_existing_row_note: Radar-specific counterpart to the established Camera Mode correspondence. Preserve both native encodings; the broader row reconciliation is not declared complete here.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Range, printed p.15 / PDF p.30
primary_records.original_meaning: Expected usable range of the component, carried as Measured Meters with required distance value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not observed distance to a detected target, a coordinate, assured detection performance or an environmental rating. The generic measured-distance type does not change the property meaning into a measured target range. Missing error is not zero uncertainty.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Resolution, printed p.16 / PDF p.31
primary_records.original_meaning: Resolution of the output produced by the component, expressed using the contextual Himelo qualitative levels.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a pixel count, angular resolution, ground sample distance, numeric precision or quality score. The source gives no conversion from the named levels to metric resolution. Keep separate from the Quality property.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Scan Time, printed p.16 / PDF p.31
primary_records.proposed_label: Duration of one complete scan-area coverage
primary_records.original_meaning: Time needed for a scanning device to cover its scan area once, carried as Measured Secs with required value and optional error.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not exposure time, pulse spacing, dwell time at one point, frame rate or a Status reporting interval. No scan start/finish timestamps, scan geometry, or performed scan are inferred.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Wavelengths, printed p.17 / PDF p.32
primary_records.original_meaning: List of wavelengths used by the laser; each value uses the native Meters simple type.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Laser-specific wavelengths, not generic sensor band limits, available wavelength capabilities or emission frequencies. No list cardinality beyond the native List indication, wavelength values, or frequency conversion is invented.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Zoom, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.proposed_label: Current camera zoom relative to maximum zoom
primary_records.original_meaning: Current zoom level of the camera as a percentage of its maximum zoom.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a lens focal length, absolute magnification factor, field of view or supported zoom range. The source does not distinguish optical from digital zoom here. The Percent base type does not impose an automatic 0–100 numeric constraint.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Receive Data Rate, printed p.15 / PDF p.30
primary_records.original_meaning: Current receiving data rate of the component, expressed as Measured Mbpsec.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not available bandwidth, rated link capacity, bytes per second, sensor sampling rate or an observation count. Mbpsec uses decimal megabits per second (10 means 10,000,000 bits/s); the optional error is not assumed zero.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Receive Power, printed p.16 / PDF p.31
primary_records.original_meaning: Strength of the received signal, represented by the Dbm type referenced to one milliwatt.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not a dimensionless Db ratio, variable-power Percent, remaining battery energy, electrical consumption or antenna gain. No signal/source/channel, reference-plane placement, filtering or sample interval is invented.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Resources, printed p.16 / PDF p.31
primary_records.original_meaning: List of accessible resources for obtaining media generated by the component, including streams and other media; each member is described by Resource Descriptor.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not physical resources/equipment inventory, an observation result itself, or proof a URL is currently reachable or authorized. Required type and URL, optional title/time fields and a metadata list that may be empty describe access; creation/modification times are not observation phenomenonTime or resultTime. Preserve the distinction from Data Inputs/Data Outputs ongoing-transfer records.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Signal Strength Ratio, printed p.16 / PDF p.31
primary_records.proposed_label: Signal Strength Ratio — reference quantity question
primary_records.original_meaning: The native property exists as a single Db value, but its original property definition states No Documentation. The Db type establishes a logarithmic ratio, not the two quantities being compared.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Do not silently equate this with signal-to-noise ratio, signal-to-interference ratio, received power in dBm, Link Loss, a percentage, or a specific reference/sign convention. Retain the source property and its declared type with ISA-Q004.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Transmit Data Rate, printed p.17 / PDF p.32
primary_records.original_meaning: Current transmitting data rate of the component, expressed as Measured Mbpsec.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Distinct from receive rate, maximum available bandwidth, transferred byte total and sensor output/sample cadence. Use the native decimal megabits-per-second value and optional error; do not infer a full-duplex sum or identify an unreported link.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Transmit Power, printed p.17 / PDF p.32
primary_records.original_meaning: Strength of the signal produced by the component, represented by the Dbm type referenced to one milliwatt.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not power supply consumption, stored-energy percentage, generic variable-power setting or necessarily effective isotropic radiated power. Do not infer antenna/feedline effects, the measurement reference plane or an active transmission merely from the property definition.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Velocity, printed p.17 / PDF p.32
primary_records.original_meaning: Absolute velocity of the device. Its composite contains required heading in the absolute XY plane and required speed magnitude, plus optional pitch measured from that plane; omitted pitch has the source default zero.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not rotational velocity, commanded motion, position, speed alone or a derivative computed from unverified station history. Retain heading/pitch/speed and the source default; absence of pitch is not a measured zero. No exact coordinate transform or frame identifier is invented; Orientation ISA-Q003 remains local.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 View Area, printed p.17 / PDF p.32
primary_records.proposed_label: Reported geographic area currently in view
primary_records.original_meaning: The geographic area currently in view, for example the physical area visible to a camera, represented as a closed Geographic Polygon.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not component position, boresight/orientation, nominal field-of-view angles, maximum coverage or inclusion/exclusion policy. The polygon has at least three ordered geographic positions and closure from last to first; do not invent surveyed accuracy, line of sight, actual detection or a GeoJSON ring conversion.

primary_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §3.1 Zones, printed p.18 / PDF p.33
primary_records.proposed_label: Ordered component inclusion and exclusion zones
primary_records.original_meaning: Full ordered set of component inclusion and exclusion areas; ordering supports nested inclusions/exclusions. Values are Area of Interest objects, with a required Geographic Shape area and an optional AOI Reason type.
primary_records.mapping_boundary: Not the area currently viewed, detection locations, unordered independent shapes or proof a policy was enforced. Preserve order, names/typed values and source optional type/default; do not invent overlap precedence, active enforcement or a measured footprint. Source does not restrict this property to a polygon-only encoding.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Count, printed p.91, PDF 106
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Core composite; source describes a positive integer count of occurrences or group members. Required value: Integer (1); optional error: Integer (0–1). Do not impose measured-float error conventions or invent reset/zero handling.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Celsius, printed p.51, PDF 66
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Float temperature in degrees Celsius; range [-273.15, infinity). A type range is not the component operational temperature rating.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Celsius, printed p.98, PDF 113
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value: Celsius (1); optional error: Celsius (0–1). Supplied error is expressed as plus/minus one standard deviation. Absence does not supply perfect accuracy.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Percent, printed p.103, PDF 118
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value: Percent (1); optional error: Percent (0–1), expressed as plus/minus one standard deviation when provided.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Secs, printed p.104, PDF 119
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value: Secs (1); optional error: Secs (0–1), expressed as plus/minus one standard deviation when provided. Property context, not type alone, establishes expected time to empty.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Percent, printed p.54, PDF 69
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Float relative to a maximum; 100 percent is considered the maximum but the base type allows exceeding it. No universal 0–100 clamp is imported.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 General State, printed p.93, PDF 108,109
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required General Code code; optional machine-readable component-specific subcode and human-readable details. Shared type does not merge power, operating or tamper conditions.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 General Code, printed p.79, PDF 94
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Sealed FAILURE, FAULT, OK, UNINITIALIZED and WARNING. Native distinctions remain; no invented power-specific or tamper-specific enum.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 String, printed p.50, PDF 65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked native String definition; reused for General State optional subcode/details without adding encoding rules.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Integer, printed p.50, PDF 65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked native integer definition, reused for Count fields without redefining the property scope.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Float, printed p.50, PDF 65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked native floating-point type, reused by Celsius, Percent and Secs.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Secs, printed p.55, PDF 70
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Floating-point seconds between instants; native representation has millisecond resolution. Not an absolute timestamp.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 Himelo, printed p.79, PDF 94–95
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Himelo is a contextual qualitative enumeration: HIGH, LOW, MEDIUM, VERY HIGH, VERY LOW. Its description derives meaning from usage; no numeric thresholds or universal metrics. Definition continues from printed p.79 to p.80. Not marked sealed.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 Polarity, printed p.80, PDF 95–95
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Polarity describes thermal-energy display palettes BLACK HOT and WHITE HOT, with the source hot/cold color ordering. Not marked sealed. These are palette values, not electrical or polarization states.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Meters, printed p.101, PDF 116–117
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Measured Meters has required value: Meters (1), optional error: Meters (0–1). A supplied error is plus/minus one standard deviation; omission is not perfect accuracy. Type does not override the Range property’s expected-usable-distance role.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Meters, printed p.53, PDF 68–69
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Meters is a floating-point linear distance in meters. Its use by Wavelengths retains the original laser property scope and list structure; no numerical wavelengths or conversions are inferred.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Dbm, printed p.52, PDF 67–67
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Float power-ratio unit in decibels referenced to one milliwatt; not the generic Db ratio or Percent. No range or measurement reference plane invented.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Db, printed p.52, PDF 67–67
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Float logarithmic ratio of two physical quantities, often power/intensity. The atomic definition does not identify the Signal Strength Ratio numerator, denominator or sign convention.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Mbpsec, printed p.53, PDF 68–68
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Float decimal megabits per second: the source example 10 denotes 10,000,000 bits/s, not megabytes/s or binary mebibits/s.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Mbpsec, printed p.101, PDF 116–116
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Mbpsec, optional error:Mbpsec (0–1). Supplied error is plus/minus one standard deviation; missing error is not zero accuracy error.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Resource Descriptor, printed p.110, PDF 125–126
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required resource type:Resource Type and url:URL, optional title:String, created:UTC and lastmod:UTC; required metadata:Name Value Pair list permits zero entries. Access descriptors are not an observation or proof of reachability.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Resource Type, printed p.111, PDF 126–126
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required primary/secondary media-type strings and required parameters:Name Value Pair list0+. Secondary fallback is plain for text or octet-stream otherwise when unknown. Do not infer actual media parameters or new registry entries.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 URL, printed p.55, PDF 70–70
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Same-edition previously checked string identifying resource location; no external request or authenticity inference is made.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 UTC, printed p.114, PDF 129–129
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Secs timestamp and optional error:Secs; creation/modification fields do not become observation occurrence/result times.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Name Value Pair, printed p.105, PDF 120–120
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required name:String and value:Wildcard; value must be a type defined in the data model. Used for resource metadata and typed zone-map entries.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 String, printed p.50, PDF 65–65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously inspected native string type reused for resource/zone names and media-type descriptions; no invented contact or identifier values.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Wildcard, printed p.50, PDF 65–65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: A declared ISA type, with context specifying the particular type. It is not permission to invent the semantics of a Zones value or resource metadata item.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Secs, printed p.55, PDF 70–70
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked floating-point interval/time representation in seconds with source millisecond-resolution constraint; no timestamp epoch or observation availability is manufactured here.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Velocity, printed p.114, PDF 129–129
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required heading:Measured Degrees in absolute XY plane, required speed:Measured Mpsec, optional pitch:Measured Degrees with source default0.0 (parallel to ground plane). Preserve source directions without choosing a new numeric frame conversion.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Mpsec, printed p.102, PDF 117–117
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Mpsec and optional error:Mpsec0–1; error when provided is plus/minus one standard deviation. Applies to speed magnitude, not a three-axis vector by itself.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Mpsec, printed p.54, PDF 69–69
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Float single-dimensional rate of distance change in meters per second. Magnitude/angle composition comes from Velocity, not this scalar type.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Degrees, printed p.98, PDF 113–114
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked required angular value and optional error in degrees; retain error qualifiers and do not substitute a quaternion or a guessed coordinate transform.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Degrees, printed p.52, PDF 67–67
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Floating point angle in degrees; actual axis/reference frame belongs to the surrounding type/property, not the scalar unit.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Float, printed p.50, PDF 65–65
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously inspected floating numeric type. No extra nonnegative bounds or coercions introduced absent the specific source definition.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Geographic Polygon, printed p.94, PDF 109–110
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required points:Geographic Position list3+, traversed in listed order and closed by connecting last element to first. No duplicated end-point requirement or ring orientation rule invented.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Geographic Position, printed p.95, PDF 110–110
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked latitude/longitude required; altitude and error terms optional with the original defaults. Preserve WGS84-geoid/EGM96 wording and do not convert defaults to surveyed accuracy.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Meters, printed p.53, PDF 68–69
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked Float linear distance in meters; reused for position/shape dependencies without assumed source-case dimensions.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Area of Interest, printed p.85, PDF 100–100
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required area:Geographic Shape and optional type:AOI Reason with source default UNKNOWN; named areas can be manipulated, anonymous ones cannot after definition. Retain source default literally without creating an adopted code list or forcing all areas into polygons.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 AOI Reason, printed p.75, PDF 90–90
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Unsealed contextual enumeration: CBRNE HAZARD, DEFENDED, DETECTION, EXCLUSION, INCLUSION, NO FLY ZONE, OTHER, SURVEILLANCE. No legal or operational validity inference. Preserve AOI composite default separately from listed enum members.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.2 Geographic Shape, printed p.84, PDF 99–99
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Union lists Geographic Arc, Geographic Ellipse, Geographic Polygon and Geographic Polyline. Preserve listed alternatives rather than inventing a polygon-only or GeoJSON equivalence. Referenced variant implementations remain assigned to their full later catalogue reviews.

supporting_definitions.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Associative Array, printed p.85, PDF 100–100
supporting_definitions.inspected_content_summary: Required values:Name Value Pair list0+; associated declaration supplies the value type. Zones adds an ordered/nested inclusion-exclusion meaning that must not be lost by treating this as an unordered collection.

source_inspection.primary_text: DMS §3.1 printed pp.15–17 / PDF pp.30–32; original indexed source definitions and extension markings read.
source_inspection.atomic_type_text: Celsius p.51/PDF66 and Percent p.54/PDF69 original definitions checked; same-edition Float, Integer, String, Secs, General State and General Code evidence reused.

case_checks: No battery state inferred from Dragino or AirGradient design battery capacities.
Campbell Battery/LithiumBattery source voltages are not Reserve Capacity percentages.
Internal Temperature is not Bennett ambient ATemp; no internal temperature value is manufactured.
No satellites-in-use count, laser use count, tamper state or power condition is attributed to any example.
Original non-ISA donor cells and all source-case values are preserved.
Polarity, laser pulse interval, scan duration, laser wavelength list and zoom do not establish any corresponding installed capability or current value for the four documentary/historical cases.
Bennett original NOAA quality flags are not an ISA Himelo quality rating. A component-output rating does not alter historical observation quality or result availability.
No particulate sensor resolution or range, radar mode, scan timing or pixel dimensions are invented from the equipment examples; previous case cells remain identical.
No case data rate or signal power is created from a nominal network interface or protocol name.
A URI or site coordinate does not establish media availability, surveyed viewing footprint, component velocity or active zone enforcement.
Bennett station geometry and the two original NOAA means remain unchanged; no transmitter power, motion or boundary data is manufactured.
mapping_note: Each native entry is individually traced. New sensing rows preserve distinct property roles and representations: two qualitative judgments, two distinct intervals, radar mode, usable range, thermal palette, laser wavelengths and relative camera zoom. Radar Mode is related to S06-R018 without overwriting its Camera Mode evidence. Candidate source roles are not automatic final-DIM field requirements.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 Himelo, printed p.79, PDF 94–95
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Himelo is a contextual qualitative enumeration: HIGH, LOW, MEDIUM, VERY HIGH, VERY LOW. Its description derives meaning from usage; no numeric thresholds or universal metrics. Definition continues from printed p.79 to p.80. Not marked sealed.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 Polarity, printed p.80, PDF 95–95
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Polarity describes thermal-energy display palettes BLACK HOT and WHITE HOT, with the source hot/cold color ordering. Not marked sealed. These are palette values, not electrical or polarization states.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Meters, printed p.101, PDF 116–117
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Measured Meters has required value: Meters (1), optional error: Meters (0–1). A supplied error is plus/minus one standard deviation; omission is not perfect accuracy. Type does not override the Range property’s expected-usable-distance role.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Secs, printed p.104, PDF 119–119
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Measured Secs has required value: Secs (1), optional error: Secs (0–1), with plus/minus one standard deviation when error is supplied. Used for distinct laser-pulse and whole-scan intervals; not timestamps.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Secs, printed p.55, PDF 70–70
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Secs is a floating-point interval in seconds; representations must have millisecond resolution. Resolution of representation is not verified measurement accuracy.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Meters, printed p.53, PDF 68–69
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Meters is a floating-point linear distance in meters. Its use by Wavelengths retains the original laser property scope and list structure; no numerical wavelengths or conversions are inferred.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Percent, printed p.54, PDF 69–69
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Percent represents a value relative to a maximum; the source permits values beyond 100. Do not invent a universal clamp, or convert camera zoom percentage into magnification without a defined relation.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 String, printed p.50, PDF 65–65
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Same-edition String definition reused for Radar Mode as a whole textual value; no invented enum, semantic version, mode vocabulary or encoding transformation.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Float, printed p.50, PDF 65–65
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Same-edition Float definition reused under Meters, Percent and Secs. Numeric representation alone does not establish physical quantity, accuracy or a particular case reading.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Dbm, printed p.52, PDF 67–67
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Float power-ratio unit in decibels referenced to one milliwatt; not the generic Db ratio or Percent. No range or measurement reference plane invented.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Db, printed p.52, PDF 67–67
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Float logarithmic ratio of two physical quantities, often power/intensity. The atomic definition does not identify the Signal Strength Ratio numerator, denominator or sign convention.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Mbpsec, printed p.53, PDF 68–68
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Float decimal megabits per second: the source example 10 denotes 10,000,000 bits/s, not megabytes/s or binary mebibits/s.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Mbpsec, printed p.101, PDF 116–116
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Mbpsec, optional error:Mbpsec (0–1). Supplied error is plus/minus one standard deviation; missing error is not zero accuracy error.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Resource Descriptor, printed p.110, PDF 125–126
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Required resource type:Resource Type and url:URL, optional title:String, created:UTC and lastmod:UTC; required metadata:Name Value Pair list permits zero entries. Access descriptors are not an observation or proof of reachability.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Resource Type, printed p.111, PDF 126–126
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Required primary/secondary media-type strings and required parameters:Name Value Pair list0+. Secondary fallback is plain for text or octet-stream otherwise when unknown. Do not infer actual media parameters or new registry entries.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 URL, printed p.55, PDF 70–70
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Same-edition previously checked string identifying resource location; no external request or authenticity inference is made.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 UTC, printed p.114, PDF 129–129
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Secs timestamp and optional error:Secs; creation/modification fields do not become observation occurrence/result times.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Name Value Pair, printed p.105, PDF 120–120
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Required name:String and value:Wildcard; value must be a type defined in the data model. Used for resource metadata and typed zone-map entries.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 String, printed p.50, PDF 65–65
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Previously inspected native string type reused for resource/zone names and media-type descriptions; no invented contact or identifier values.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Wildcard, printed p.50, PDF 65–65
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: A declared ISA type, with context specifying the particular type. It is not permission to invent the semantics of a Zones value or resource metadata item.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Secs, printed p.55, PDF 70–70
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked floating-point interval/time representation in seconds with source millisecond-resolution constraint; no timestamp epoch or observation availability is manufactured here.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Velocity, printed p.114, PDF 129–129
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Required heading:Measured Degrees in absolute XY plane, required speed:Measured Mpsec, optional pitch:Measured Degrees with source default0.0 (parallel to ground plane). Preserve source directions without choosing a new numeric frame conversion.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Mpsec, printed p.102, PDF 117–117
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Required value:Mpsec and optional error:Mpsec0–1; error when provided is plus/minus one standard deviation. Applies to speed magnitude, not a three-axis vector by itself.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Mpsec, printed p.54, PDF 69–69
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Float single-dimensional rate of distance change in meters per second. Magnitude/angle composition comes from Velocity, not this scalar type.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Measured Degrees, printed p.98, PDF 113–114
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked required angular value and optional error in degrees; retain error qualifiers and do not substitute a quaternion or a guessed coordinate transform.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Degrees, printed p.52, PDF 67–67
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Floating point angle in degrees; actual axis/reference frame belongs to the surrounding type/property, not the scalar unit.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.1 Float, printed p.50, PDF 65–65
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Previously inspected floating numeric type. No extra nonnegative bounds or coercions introduced absent the specific source definition.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Geographic Polygon, printed p.94, PDF 109–110
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Required points:Geographic Position list3+, traversed in listed order and closed by connecting last element to first. No duplicated end-point requirement or ring orientation rule invented.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Geographic Position, printed p.95, PDF 110–110
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked latitude/longitude required; altitude and error terms optional with the original defaults. Preserve WGS84-geoid/EGM96 wording and do not convert defaults to surveyed accuracy.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §4.2 Meters, printed p.53, PDF 68–69
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Previously checked Float linear distance in meters; reused for position/shape dependencies without assumed source-case dimensions.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Area of Interest, printed p.85, PDF 100–100
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Required area:Geographic Shape and optional type:AOI Reason with source default UNKNOWN; named areas can be manipulated, anonymous ones cannot after definition. Retain source default literally without creating an adopted code list or forcing all areas into polygons.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.1 AOI Reason, printed p.75, PDF 90–90
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Unsealed contextual enumeration: CBRNE HAZARD, DEFENDED, DETECTION, EXCLUSION, INCLUSION, NO FLY ZONE, OTHER, SURVEILLANCE. No legal or operational validity inference. Preserve AOI composite default separately from listed enum members.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.2 Geographic Shape, printed p.84, PDF 99–99
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Union lists Geographic Arc, Geographic Ellipse, Geographic Polygon and Geographic Polyline. Preserve listed alternatives rather than inventing a polygon-only or GeoJSON equivalence. Referenced variant implementations remain assigned to their full later catalogue reviews.

checked_or_reused_records.source_locator: ISA DMS 6.0r12 §8.3 Associative Array, printed p.85, PDF 100–100
checked_or_reused_records.inspected_content_summary: Required values:Name Value Pair list0+; associated declaration supplies the value type. Zones adds an ordered/nested inclusion-exclusion meaning that must not be lost by treating this as an unordered collection.

source_inspections_by_pass.signal_ratio_search: All four exact DMS occurrences inspected (contents, Radio bin, property and index); none supplies a defining ratio beyond Db. Source explicitly states No Documentation.

specific_questions.known: DMS §3.1 declares Db / Single Value and explicitly gives No Documentation; §4.2 Db defines a logarithmic ratio. The Radio capability-bin listing names it but does not define the ratio.
specific_questions.question: Which signal quantities/reference and sign convention does Signal Strength Ratio compare?
specific_questions.decision: Keep native Signal Strength Ratio and Db visible. No unsupported signal-to-noise/interference ratio, dBm power or Link Loss equivalence.
specific_questions.evidence: DMS §3.1 printed p.16/PDF31; §4.2 Db printed p.52/PDF67; catalogue occurrence search found contents, Radio bin, property and index only.
specific_questions.next_resolution: ISA-09/11 communications-type and companion reconciliation: use original technical clarification if available. Otherwise retain this precise source-definition gap; do not repeat the completed property review.
